title: decision: identifierQuery answers exact handle queries for local users only
description: protocol-06 §5.8 L2337-2563. Mark 2026-11-02 chose option B over always-forbidden and an opt-in list. Rules: every query_element must be searchType handle, else responseCode unsupportedField; an empty query_elements list (decodable per decision .5.73) gets forbidden (an unspecified combination is not allowed, §5.8), not 'match everyone'; all handle elements (AND semantics) must equal, byte-exact (as decision .5.58), the mimi:// URI of one local user who is known (has at least one client, as .7.36), giving success with uri=[that URI] and no foundProfiles; otherwise notFound. Trade-off accepted: anyone who already knows a user URI can confirm it exists. Upgrade path: per-user search policy once a JMAP surface (.12) exists.
